attributes.title: run_security_audit
attributes.description: Run a full gateway security audit and return every finding, the posture score, the inventory the findings cite, and the role-to-page access matrix. This is the primary tool -- call it first for any question about the gateway's security posture. The findings are computed deterministically by gateway code, not by you: do not invent, merge or re-grade them, and do not report a problem that is not in the list. Optionally pass 'domain' to narrow to one area when the user asks a focused follow-up question, which returns the same inventory with only that area's findings.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Narrow the findings to one area: 'users' (accounts, roles, password hygiene), 'gateway' (security properties, security levels, identity providers, API tokens), 'pages' (Perspective page and view access), or 'resources' (AI agents, MCP servers, tool bundles, WebDev endpoints). Omit for everything.
